event_chain.summary: Unauthorized access to internal IT infrastructure

summary: In early July 2026 North Media A/S disclosed that its Swedish subsidiary SDR Svensk Direktreklam had detected unauthorized external access to its internal IT infrastructure. SDR was investigating with external security experts and legal advisers whether personal or customer data had been accessed, reported the incident to Swedish authorities, and said day-to-day operations continued without impact on customers or partners. No other North Media businesses were affected.
